purpose: Defines what it would mean for this system to have demonstrated cross-domain accuracy. Written BEFORE the evidence that could satisfy it exists, so that the thresholds cannot be chosen to fit a result. Applying it today returns NOT ESTIMABLE, which is the honest current answer.

hard_gates.why: a discrepancy released as a clean match is the failure the whole design exists to prevent; it is never traded against accuracy
a value released about an arm or comparison it did not come from
a value released as if it counted a population it did not count
every true discrepancy must reach a human by some route
an answer key changed to fit model output is not an answer key — only an attestation can state this; a run cannot certify itself
a result that does not reproduce from its own recording is not a result — only an attestation can state this; a run cannot certify itself

capability_gates.why: the audit's reason to exist is finding real discrepancies; the bound is on the cluster-bootstrap lower limit, not the point estimate
a flag a human must dismiss more often than not is a burden, not a finding; deliberately looser than recall because a false flag costs review time and a missed one costs correctness
a value was located at all. Deliberately NOT evidence that it was the right value: see auditable_coverage
located AND judgeable: the arm was identified, the population was established, and the evidence protocol held. A system can raise retrieval coverage by accepting anything; this is what it cannot fake

notes: The unit of analysis is the STUDY. Rows from one paper move together, so intervals are bootstrapped over studies and a one-study benchmark supports no interval at all.
label_accuracy is reported, never gated: it mixes safety, capability and coverage into one number, and a system can raise it by refusing less.
Refusal is measured beside safety (scope_assessable_rate, source_coverage). A system that refuses everything satisfies every hard gate and has audited nothing.
The minimums are provisional. They are stated in advance so that changing them requires a new version and a written reason, not so that they are already known to be right.

STILL REQUIRED BEFORE THIS GATE CAN BE CALLED FINAL: a clinician's judgement on acceptable missed-discrepancy risk (the 0.70 recall bound is an engineering guess), and confirmation that the answer keys for any new domain were built by someone qualified in that domain.
An absent safety number is not a zero. Four states per hard gate: never reported, reported with nothing graded against it, graded and held, graded and failed. Only the third is a pass.
Coverage is two numbers. retrieval_coverage counts a value found; auditable_coverage counts a value the audit could actually judge.
Meeting this gate does not authorise a release while its status is provisional: evaluation and authorisation are separate verdicts.
supersedes_reason: v1's thresholds were sound but the checker applying them was not: missing safety evidence was read as zero, two gates were hard-coded, and intervals depended on the order reports were named. Results reported under v1 are withdrawn. v1 itself is left byte-identical, because a pre-registration that edits its own history is worth nothing — the correction is a new version, not a revision of the old one.
changes_from_v1: estimand fixed as domain-weighted with studies resampled inside each domain
held-out domain excluded from the pooled estimate and reported alone
undefined resamples reported; above max_undefined_draw_rate the interval is refused
per-domain discrepancy minimums and a minimum number of studies carrying one
hard gates gained an evidence denominator, so zero-out-of-zero is not a pass

estimand.definition: Each domain contributes equally; within a domain, studies are resampled with replacement. Rows are never resampled and never pooled across domains for the headline figure.
estimand.why: Nine EAT studies beside one melanoma study would otherwise make the headline number a report on EAT.
estimand.honesty_note: This choice RAISED the observed figures — melanoma's small, clean set now counts as much as EAT's larger one. It was made because of the 9:1 imbalance and is recorded here so it cannot later look like a choice made after seeing which way it went.
estimand.held_out_domain: excluded from the pooled estimate and reported alone
estimand.undefined_draws: reported as a rate; above max_undefined_draw_rate the interval is refused rather than computed from the draws that happened to work
